COMMERCIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

Landlord: Harborline Properties III, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company
Tenant: Meridian Northwest Coffee Roasters, Inc., a Washington corporation

Premises: Suite 200, 1400 Western Avenue, Seattle, WA 98101 (approximately 6,842 rentable square feet on the second floor of the Harborline Building)

Effective Date: February 1, 2026
Commencement Date: April 1, 2026 (subject to Landlord's delivery of possession in the Delivery Condition described in Exhibit C)
Expiration Date: March 31, 2036 (ten-year term)

1. BASE RENT
   (a) Year 1: $42.00/RSF/year = $287,364.00/year ($23,947.00/month)
   (b) Year 2: $43.26/RSF (3.0% escalation)
   (c) Years 3–10: 3.0% annual compounding escalation
   Rent is payable in advance on the first day of each month, without demand, deduction, or set-off, at Landlord's address or such other address as Landlord may designate.

2. ADDITIONAL RENT (NNN)
   Tenant shall pay its Proportionate Share (14.8%) of Operating Expenses, Real Estate Taxes, and Insurance for the Building, subject to the following:
   (a) Base Year: Calendar Year 2026 for Real Estate Taxes only.
   (b) Controllable Operating Expenses shall not increase by more than 5% year-over-year on a cumulative basis.
   (c) Landlord shall deliver an annual reconciliation statement within 120 days after each calendar year-end.

3. SECURITY DEPOSIT
   Tenant shall deposit $71,841.00 (equivalent to three months' Base Rent) upon execution. Landlord may draw upon the Security Deposit for uncured defaults after notice. Tenant may substitute a Letter of Credit meeting the requirements of Exhibit D.

4. PERMITTED USE
   The Premises shall be used solely for (i) coffee roasting on equipment identified in Exhibit E (2 x Loring S15 Falcon roasters, each with integrated afterburners); (ii) wholesale coffee distribution; (iii) coffee tasting and public-facing retail sales limited to no more than 1,200 RSF of the Premises; and (iv) associated general office use. Tenant shall obtain and maintain all required City of Seattle permits, including the Puget Sound Clean Air Agency Notice of Construction approval for the roasters.

5. TENANT IMPROVEMENTS
   Landlord shall provide a Tenant Improvement Allowance of $75.00/RSF ($513,150.00), disbursed upon Tenant's submission of paid invoices and unconditional lien waivers. Improvements shall be constructed pursuant to Space Plan No. 2026-04-Rev3 dated March 22, 2026, prepared by Sundberg Kennedy Ly-Au Young Architects.

6. ASSIGNMENT AND SUBLETTING
   Tenant may not assign or sublet without Landlord's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Tenant may assign or sublet without consent to (a) an entity controlling, controlled by, or under common control with Tenant, or (b) the acquirer of substantially all of Tenant's assets, provided that the transferee has a Tangible Net Worth equal to or greater than Tenant's Tangible Net Worth as of the Effective Date.

7. HAZARDOUS MATERIALS
   Tenant shall not release Hazardous Materials at the Premises. Green coffee bean fumigants (methyl bromide, phosphine) are expressly prohibited on-site. Tenant shall indemnify Landlord for any environmental liability arising from Tenant's operations.

8. INSURANCE
   Tenant shall maintain (a) commercial general liability insurance with limits of not less than $2,000,000 per occurrence / $5,000,000 aggregate; (b) property insurance on Tenant's personal property and trade fixtures; and (c) worker's compensation as required by law. Landlord and its property manager (Kilroy Realty Management) shall be named as additional insureds.

9. DEFAULT AND REMEDIES
   The following constitute Events of Default: (a) failure to pay Rent within 5 business days after written notice; (b) failure to perform any other covenant within 30 days after written notice (extended if cure requires longer and Tenant diligently pursues cure); (c) bankruptcy or insolvency; (d) unauthorized assignment or subletting. Upon default, Landlord may terminate the Lease and recover damages equal to the unpaid Rent plus the present value of future Rent (discounted at the Federal Reserve Prime Rate plus 1%) less the fair rental value of the Premises for the balance of the Term.

10. GOVERNING LAW; VENUE
    Washington law governs. Venue lies in King County Superior Court.

11. GUARANTY
    This Lease is guaranteed by the Personal Guaranty of Marisol T. Kettering, Chief Executive Officer of Tenant, in the form attached as Exhibit F, limited to $500,000 and burning off over 60 months of on-time payment.
